meta.title: Michael's Gallery
meta.description: Portrait, wedding and landscape photography in El Salvador.

home.rights: © {year} Michael's Gallery. All photographs belong to their author.

access.title: Your photographs are ready.
access.lede: Enter the six-character code from your delivery email. It opens a private gallery that only you and the people you share it with can see.
access.label: Access code
access.wrong: That code doesn't match a gallery. Check your delivery email.
access.expired: This gallery closed on {date}. Write to Michael and he can reopen it.
access.blocked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
access.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
access.preparing: Your gallery is still being prepared. Try again in a few minutes.

gallery.guestNote: Guest view: you can browse and heart favourites, but not download.
gallery.empty: No favourites yet. Tap the heart on any photograph to keep it here.
gallery.note: Previews are web-sized copies. Downloads are the untouched originals, pulled from storage when you ask for them.
gallery.zipSub: {count} originals, {size}. Large galleries are split into parts of about 2 GB; download each one.
gallery.keys: Arrows to move, F to favourite, Esc to close.
